def _get_instance(model, pk):
    try:
        return model.objects.get(pk=pk)
    except model.DoesNotExist:
        raise GraphQLError(f"{model.__name__} with id {pk} does not exist.") from None


def _save_instance(instance, data, many_to_many):
    for key, value in data.items():
        if key not in many_to_many:
            setattr(instance, key, value)
    # Only validate what the caller supplied: values the model fills in itself
    # (for example an empty JSON default) would otherwise fail the blank check.
    exclude = [
        field.name
        for field in instance._meta.fields
        if field.name not in data and field.attname not in data
    ]
    try:
        instance.full_clean(exclude=exclude)
    except ValidationError as error:
        raise GraphQLError("; ".join(error.messages)) from error
    instance.save()
    for key, name in many_to_many.items():
        if data.get(key) is not None:
            getattr(instance, name).set(data[key])
    return instance

    order_list = graphene.List(graphene.NonNull(OrderType), required=True)
    order_line = graphene.Field(OrderLineType, id=graphene.ID(required=True))
    order_line_list = graphene.List(graphene.NonNull(OrderLineType), required=True)
    account = graphene.Field(AccountType, id=graphene.ID(required=True))
    account_list = graphene.List(graphene.NonNull(AccountType), required=True)
    tenant = graphene.Field(TenantType, id=graphene.ID(required=True))
    tenant_list = graphene.List(graphene.NonNull(TenantType), required=True)
    profile_list = graphene.List(graphene.NonNull(ProfileType), required=True)
    document = graphene.Field(DocumentType, id=graphene.ID(required=True))
    document_list = graphene.List(graphene.NonNull(DocumentType), required=True)
    scratch = graphene.Field(ScratchType, id=graphene.ID(required=True))
    scratch_list = graphene.List(graphene.NonNull(ScratchType), required=True)
    document_summary = graphene.Field(DocumentSummaryType, id=graphene.ID(required=True))
    document_summary_list = graphene.List(graphene.NonNull(DocumentSummaryType), required=True)

    def resolve_order_list(root, info):
        return Order.objects.all()

    def resolve_order_line(root, info, id):
        return OrderLine.objects.filter(pk=id).first()

    def resolve_order_line_list(root, info):
        return OrderLine.objects.all()

    def resolve_account(root, info, id):
        return Account.objects.filter(pk=id).first()

    def resolve_account_list(root, info):
        return Account.objects.all()

    def resolve_tenant(root, info, id):
        return Tenant.objects.filter(pk=id).first()

    def resolve_tenant_list(root, info):
        return Tenant.objects.all()

    def resolve_profile_list(root, info):
        return Profile.objects.all()

    def resolve_document(root, info, id):
        return Document.objects.filter(pk=id).first()

    def resolve_document_list(root, info):
        return Document.objects.all()

    def resolve_scratch(root, info, id):
        return Scratch.objects.filter(pk=id).first()

    def resolve_scratch_list(root, info):
        return Scratch.objects.all()

    def resolve_document_summary(root, info, id):
        return DocumentSummary.objects.filter(pk=id).first()

    def resolve_document_summary_list(root, info):
        return DocumentSummary.objects.all()
